motion.right:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset: WALK and RUN animation spritesheet for KLED, Yuuki's ADULT FATHER, for the existing top-down pixel RPG.
Input image1 is the USER-APPROVED Kled identity. Keep EXACTLY his mature angular masculine face, narrow RED eyes, serious calm expression, layered BLACK shoulder-length hair with side-swept fringe and dangling earrings; fitted BLACK high-open-collar cloth shirt with sleeves rolled to forearms, black trousers, black belt and dark buckle, black lace-up shoes; TWO WHITE feathered wings. SAME adult male body proportions, broad shoulders and head-to-body ratio as reference, NOT a child/chibi, no baby eyes or shortened adult legs. Maintain the approved clothing, face and hairstyle in EVERY frame. Do not mirror the face/hair part across different phases.
Polished crisp pixel-art clustered shading and subtle dimensional fabric/feather volume as reference, sharp edges, no blur or smeared strands.
Layout: FOUR columns and TWO rows, EXACTLY8 full-body poses. First row four walking frames, second row four running frames. Equal cells with generous fully transparent gutters and outer margins. Every wing tip, shoe, hand and hair tip entirely inside its OWN cell. Stable equal head/body size and registration throughout. No idle row here. ACTUAL transparent RGBA background; no scenery, labels, checkerboard or floor shadow. NO HALO in any body sprite; the halo remains a separate recolorable layer.
Gait: ordered four phases, contactA ->passingA ->opposite contactB ->opposite passingB ->contactA. Even modest changes between neighbors and on4to1. Stable femur/shin lengths and same shoe sizes, no sudden elongation. Passing frames2/4 MUST have shoes much closer together than contact frames1/3. Walk small relaxed stride and gentle reciprocal arm swing. Run slightly longer compact stride, modest bent elbows and small forward lean, not jumping or splits. Hair and tucked resting white wings sway slightly; NO wing flapping or flying. Both sides of trouser fabric maintain same proportions and shades, no changing shirt or losing belt/earrings.

DIRECTION: ALL eight frames face SCREEN-RIGHT, same three-quarter SIDE camera. Both white wings trail behind toward screen-left. Frame1 near/right-leading shoe forward to screen-right and far shoe behind; frame2 near shoe supporting UNDER hips and far shoe passing CLOSE alongside with soft knee bend; frame3 FAR shoe now leads forward and near leg trails, arm swing opposite of1; frame4 FAR shoe supports below hip, near shoe passes CLOSE alongside. In BOTH rows, alternating wide modest contact and close passing silhouettes, not four repeated spread-leg poses. Keep same right-facing face angle throughout.
